about: Closed set of reviewed sentences for every public copy field a model can influence (design 1.8, R2.2). The model picks template and phrase IDs only. Code binds typed slot values, renders the template, and compares the WHOLE final field to the rendering: anything else is rejected and the field takes its deterministic default (section defaults). A story with no supported text is omitted. Template text holds no digit, no number word, no currency and no factual assertion beyond the slots it declares.

grammar.slot: {slot_name} or {slot_name|cap} (cap = first letter upper-case, nothing else changed); {slot|a} puts a or an before the value (an before a vowel letter), nothing else changed
grammar.phrase: {phrase:<bank>} takes one phrase from voice-phrases.json bank <bank> by ID, kind and category allowed
grammar.sentence_rule: sentences = count of [.!?] followed by space or end of the rendered text

no_copying.rule: design 3.2: no 8+-word span of the final description may appear in another catalog description. Compare normalised word lists: lower-case, letters and digits only, words split on any other character; punctuation and sentence breaks do not separate a span.
no_copying.compare_with: every other description in storefront-mockup/shop-data.json and every description already published or committed by the pipeline; never the same listing's own earlier versions
resolution: 1. render the model's selection; if it shares a span with another description, step 2
2. swap one bank phrase at a time for the next allowed phrase of that bank in file order (kind and category allowed), keeping the template; take the first rendering with no shared span
3. use rung a of defaults.description for the kind (key flowers for category flowers); if it shares a span, rung b (desc-default-short)

4. both rungs shared a span: stop and treat it as a failing case for hass-npp-maintain (two other listings published with these exact fallbacks whose names share 6 or more words of prefix and suffix with this item's); never publish a copying description and never skip the check
no_copying.why_defaults_are_anchored: a default made only of bank phrases is identical for every product of the kind, so after the first one is published every later fallback would be a copy

item.note: plain product name from S2, code-normalised (single spaces); keeps the product kind

brand.note: public only from his words or a verified official-site fact; else the field uses the no-brand template

size_text.note: label size as printed, OCR-confirmed on the source photo; never from his typed words

name.note: the already validated public product name

town.note: the place the maker is based in; same provenance rule as brand

founded.note: four digit year; the only digits copy may carry besides size_text

templates.text: Pick up {item} for the kitchen. Set {item} out on the table.
Pick up {item} for the glass. Taste {item}, then decide.
Pick up {item} for the counter. Wash {item}, taste, and decide.
Pick up {item} for the house. Put {item} in the front room.
Pick up {item} for the house. Keep {item} close at hand.
{maker_name} makes {makes}. The business was founded in {founded}.
{maker_name} is {nature|a} in {town}, and it makes {makes}. It was founded in {founded}.

defaults.name: name-item
defaults.description_rule: the deterministic description is the first rung of the ladder for the product kind (the key flowers when the category is flowers, otherwise the kind) that passes the no-copying resolution below. Every rung is ANCHORED: it carries the product's own name in each sentence and no bank phrase, so it is never the same text for two products. Rung a (kind specific) has at most 5 fixed words between two name slots. Rung b (desc-default-short, all kinds) has at most 2, so two names that share a prefix and a suffix of up to 5 words in total (the same brand and the same kind of product) still share no span of 8 words. A rung needs only the item slot, so it can always be rendered.

story.select: first template in order whose required facts are all kept and whose slots can all be bound; none qualifies means the story is omitted
story.phrase: the default story_close phrase where the template has one
